intro.h2: Big remodels, handled from plan to walkthrough
paragraphs: Devlin Remodeling LLC is a home remodeler in Independence, KY, led by Keith. The team takes on the projects that change how a house works: kitchens, master baths, finished basements, decks, covered patios and pergolas. On some jobs it handles everything from start to finish, including the design, tile selection and color palette.

What reviewers praise most is how the job is run. They describe planning that felt organized, a crew that left the house clean at the end of each day, and Keith being upfront about costs and any changes. Cabinets and stone come from hand-selected partners such as Tru Grain Woodworks and Raisbeck Stoneworks. One patio customer says the team even checked in on them a year later.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens come up often in Google reviews. One kitchen paired black shaker cabinets with a white stone island, and an August 2026 post shows a full before and after transformation. Devlin has thanked partners Tru Grain Woodworks and Raisbeck Stoneworks for the cabinetry and stone on its projects.

image.alt: Kitchen with black shaker cabinets, stainless appliances and a white stone island with seating

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Dated corner tubs and builder vanities become bright master baths with freestanding tubs, walk-in glass showers and new vanities. Sometimes it is hard to picture what a space could be, so on some projects the team handles the design, tile selection and color palette from start to finish.

image.alt: Light wood bathroom vanity with brass fixtures next to a sliding barn door

items.name: Basement finishing
items.blurb: Finished basements come up often in Google reviews too. One family got hardwood stairs, quartz countertops, custom cabinetry and bar shelving, plus a powder room in dark picket tile, for what they called a moody-but-warm space.

image.alt: Finished basement bar with charcoal front, white counter, open shelving and light wood-look floor

items.name: Decks, covered patios and pergolas
items.blurb: Outdoor rooms get the same care. Projects include a covered patio with wood-wrapped posts and ceiling fans, a lean-to and pergola, a custom deck finished despite a rainy stretch, and a deck transformation that came together in one week.

image.alt: New covered patio with wood-wrapped posts, recessed lights and a concrete pad behind a two-story home

items.name: Whole-home and exterior updates
items.blurb: Some clients need more than one room. A 2024 project gave a couple of 60 years a renovated home inside and out, plus a new deck. Exterior work includes updates like painted brick and new black trim, shown in before and after photos.

image.alt: Before and after of a brick home exterior, red brick on top and painted white brick with black trim below

about.h2: Keith, Liz and the Devlin Remodeling team
about.text: Devlin Remodeling LLC is led by Keith, the name homeowners mention first in their reviews. Reviewers also thank Liz, and Julian, whose crew keeps job sites tidy and homeowners in the loop. Keith works with a short list of trusted trade partners, including Tru Grain Woodworks for custom cabinetry and Raisbeck Stoneworks for stone. Customers describe a company that answers questions right away, keeps them informed at all times and comes back to check on the work later. One says Keith would be their first call for the next project.

testimonials.h2: From Devlin Remodeling customers on Google

items.name: Jackie F.
items.text:
🙌🏻 Keith and his team brought our basement vision to life in a way that exceeded what we had imagined from the start. From the initial planning through the final walkthrough, the entire process felt organized, thoughtful, and collaborative.

A special shoutout to Julian and his crew— they were efficient, respectful of our home, and consistently left the space clean at the end of each day. They also made a point to keep us informed and involved throughout the build, which made a big difference in our confidence in the process.

We also worked with several of Keith’s hand-selected partners, and the quality of their craftsmanship truly elevated the finished space. The hardwood stairs and quartz countertops completely transformed the basement, and the custom cabinetry and bar shelving created exactly the moody-but-warm atmosphere we were hoping for.

Most importantly, we were looking for a team we could trust with a major home investment, and Keith and his team delivered on that. If you’re considering a basement remodel and want quality workmanship with a team that stands behind their work, we highly recommend Devlin Remodeling.

items.name: Mary
items.text:
Keith and Liz and their team did a great job.  We had a Lean-2 and Pergola built. Their service was excellent, the best we have encountered. Their response to any questions and or concern's were handled right away. They kept us informed about the job at all times.  Keith is very upfront and lets you know what the cost were and if there were any changes. We appreciated the honesty and quality of their work.  We would recommend them to friends and family or anyone who asks…
We would not go to any other remodeling company. Devlin remodeling has our trust and loyalty and if we would need any more work done Keith would be our first call… they are a company who stands behind all of their work. That’s really hard to find today.

items.name: April C.
items.text: We were looking for someone to do a covered patio and came across Keith and team. They took our vision and brought it to life. What an A+ team. They are the best at what they do and communicate so great throughout the whole project and even have checked in on us a year later. We couldn’t have asked for a better team to do our patio! So glad we found them! If I could give more than 5 stars, I definitely would! Highly recommend Keith and his great team!

service_area.h2: Your home remodeler in Independence, KY
service_area.text: Devlin Remodeling LLC is listed by the Better Business Bureau in Independence, Kentucky, and works from there on kitchens, bathrooms, basements and outdoor projects. Its Google profile does not list a street address or a set service area, so the best way to check whether your home is in range is to call (859) 380-0370 during office hours, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Kitchens, bathrooms, finished basements, decks, covered patios, lean-tos and pergolas, and whole-home updates inside and out. Kitchens and basements come up often in Google reviews. If your project is not on that list, call (859) 380-0370 and describe it so the team can tell you whether it fits.

items.q: Will I know what things cost as we go?
items.a: Reviewers say yes. Mary wrote that Keith is very upfront and lets you know what the costs are and if there are any changes. Other customers say questions and concerns were handled right away and they were kept informed about the job at all times.

items.q: Who does the cabinets and countertops?
items.a: Devlin Remodeling works with trusted partners. In September 2026 it thanked Tru Grain Woodworks for cabinetry and Raisbeck Stoneworks for stone installation. One basement client said the craftsmanship of Keith's hand-selected partners truly elevated the finished space, including the quartz countertops and custom bar shelving.

Google lists office hours Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday. Call (859) 380-0370 or email devlinremodeling00@gmail.com with a few photos of your space and a short note on what you would like to change, and the team can follow up.

items.q: Can you help me picture what my space could be?
items.a: Yes. Devlin Remodeling says it can be hard to envision the full potential of a space, and that is where the team comes in. On one 2026 project it handled the design, tile selection and color palette from start to finish. A basement client said the result exceeded what they had imagined.

final_cta.h2: Have a space you want to rethink?
final_cta.text: Call Keith and the team to talk through your kitchen, bath, basement or patio.
